lead.event: Rupiah reaches record lows against the US dollar on November 25-26
lead.headline: Rupiah closes at record-low Rp18,335 per US dollar on 26 November
lead.blurb: After closing at Rp18,332 per US dollar on 25 November, the rupiah touched Rp18,400 at 11:48 WIB on 26 November. Bank Indonesia attributed the weakness to global risk-off sentiment, a strong dollar, concerns over a possible MSCI reclassification and month-end corporate dollar demand. It said it was intervening in offshore and domestic currency markets and buying government securities in the secondary market.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: 6 new articles with a new fact: The rupiah closed at a record-low Rp18,335 per US dollar on 26 November.

market_structure_policy.event: Bank Indonesia cuts conventional banks' reserve requirement to 7%
market_structure_policy.headline: Bank Indonesia cuts conventional banks' reserve requirement to 7% from 1 December
market_structure_policy.blurb: BI has also lowered the macroprudential liquidity incentive limit from 6% to 5%. The reserve requirement fell from 9% to 8% on 1 November and reaches 7% on 1 December, leaving effective GWM at 2% for banks receiving the maximum incentive.

market_structure_policy.event: Bank SMBC Indonesia advances its plan to go private and delist
market_structure_policy.headline: BTPN plans to go private and delist, with details due 30 November
market_structure_policy.blurb: Bank SMBC Indonesia notified OJK and the IDX on 19 November that it plans to seek shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting. Further details are due with the meeting announcement on 30 November.

market_structure_policy.event: IDX excludes High Shareholding Concentration stocks from JCI weighting
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX sets JCI weighting exclusion for HSC stocks on 383-issuer list
market_structure_policy.blurb: The exchange cited higher price-fluctuation risk and potential tracking error for passive investors. Krom Bank, whose shareholding concentration is 99.94%, is exploring consolidation and awaits new OJK rules.

other.event: Adaro Andalan Indonesia announces a US$500 million interim dividend
other.headline: AADI announces US$500 million interim dividend for 2026
other.blurb: Adaro Andalan shares rose 4.29% to Rp10,325 in the first trading session on 26 November. The payout is double the US$250 million interim dividend paid in 2025 and comes from net profit for the nine months to 30 September. The per-share amount has not been announced, and payment is scheduled for 11 December, after cum-dividend dates of 3 December for regular and negotiation markets and 7 December for the cash market.
other.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: AADI shares rose 4.29% to Rp10,325 in the first trading session on 26 November.

other.event: Adhi Karya secures Rp1.29 trillion contract for 26 irrigation projects
other.headline: ADHI secures Rp1.29 trillion contract for 26 irrigation projects
other.blurb: The award directly impacts Adhi Karya's construction order backlog. Further details were not available.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Bank Syariah Indonesia plans a rights issue of up to 6.8 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BRIS plans rights issue of up to 6.8 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bank Syariah Indonesia shareholders approved the plan on 6 November, and the new shares would represent 12.85% of post-issue capital. If Bank Mandiri, BNI and BRI do not exercise their rights, their stakes would fall to 44.85%, 20.25% and 13.40%, respectively. The exercise price and rights ratio are due after an OJK effective statement targeted for 3 February 2027.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: If Bank Mandiri, BNI and BRI do not exercise their rights, their stakes would fall to 44.85%, 20.25% and 13.40%, respectively.

earnings_guidance.event: Mahkota Group reports nine-month results and sets 2026 financial targets
earnings_guidance.headline: MGRO swings to Rp45.65 billion nine-month profit, targets Rp75 billion for 2026
earnings_guidance.blurb: January-September revenue rose to Rp6.55 trillion from Rp4.93 trillion a year earlier, while using palm oil mill effluent as renewable energy cut costs by Rp17.4 billion. MGRO also targets Rp9 trillion in 2026 revenue.

earnings_guidance.event: Mirae Asset downgrades Indonesia’s telecommunications sector to Neutral
earnings_guidance.headline: Mirae Asset downgrades Indonesia telecoms to Neutral on Rp15 trillion TLKM outflow risk
earnings_guidance.blurb: The broker cited potential foreign outflows of up to US$850 million, including about Rp15 trillion from Telkom Indonesia, amid uncertainty over MSCI classification and market accessibility. It raised its cost-of-equity assumption to 16.5–17.5% from 14.0–14.5% and cut average sector target prices by 26%; core profit across the sector weakened 34.8% quarter on quarter in Q3 2026.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: Core profit across the sector weakened 34.8% quarter on quarter in Q3 2026.

earnings_guidance.event: Bumi Resources reports nine-month 2026 financial results
earnings_guidance.headline: BUMI reports 9M 2026 profit of US$148.47 million, up 404.9%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bumi Resources’ revenue rose 38.85% to US$1.44 billion. Long-term loans and bonds increased 122.7% to US$694.2 million.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: Long-term loans and bonds increased 122.7% to US$694.2 million.

earnings_guidance.event: Analysts issue buy recommendations and target prices for Energi Mega Persada
earnings_guidance.headline: Analysts recommend ENRG as 2027 gas output is forecast to rise 15.5%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Ciptadana sets a Rp800 target and Samuel a Rp1,200 target, while analyst consensus averages Rp1,460 per share. Energi Mega Persada’s gas output is projected to rise from 211.0 BBTUD in 2026 to 243.8 BBTUD in 2027, driven by new projects.

deals_control.event: Energi Mega Persada completes US$200 million investment in HighPeak Energy
deals_control.headline: Energi Mega Persada completes US$200 million investment in HighPeak Energy
deals_control.blurb: The investment was made through subsidiary Tunas Harapan Perkasa in Nasdaq-listed HighPeak Energy. Energi Mega Persada said it targets operational synergies and technology transfer, with the deal potentially adding around 47 million barrels of oil equivalent in economic exposure to its 14-asset portfolio.

deals_control.event: Trimegah Sekuritas executes Rp278.84 billion reverse repo of Energi Mega Persada shares
deals_control.headline: TRIM executes Rp278.84 billion reverse repo of ENRG shares
deals_control.blurb: Trimegah Sekuritas completed the transaction on 25 November at Rp555 per share for 502.42 million shares. Its ENRG holdings fell to 4.26 billion shares, or 10.71%, from 4.76 billion shares, or 11.97%.

deals_control.event: BCA Sekuritas acquires 5.41% stake in Darma Henwa
deals_control.headline: BCA Sekuritas acquires 5.41% stake in DEWA
deals_control.blurb: BCA Sekuritas bought 2.2 billion shares on 24 November for an estimated Rp490.55 billion, according to Stockbit's estimate based on KSEI data. Darma Henwa shares rose 1.71% to Rp238 on 26 November.
